entities.name: PMID:27507899
observations: In 18 ALS patients with chronic respiratory failure, pressure pain thresholds during unassisted breathing decreased a median 24.5–33.0% after NIV for 30 or 60 minutes (p<0.05); authors described this as associated with dyspnoea relief, with clinical implications undetermined.

entities.name: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
observations: The study enrolled 18 patients with chronic respiratory failure due to ALS.

entities.name: NIV lowers pain threshold
observations: Short-term NIV in 18 ALS patients was associated with a median 24.5–33.0% reduction in deltoid pressure-pain threshold at 30 and 60 minutes (p<0.05); clinical significance remains unknown.
